name: Process & SOP {OS}
tagline: Turn a thing you do well into a thing anyone can do.

commands.name: /sop-capture
commands.summary: Extract the real procedure from the expert, including the judgement calls.

commands.name: /sop-decisions
commands.summary: Turn every it-depends into named branches with their criteria.

commands.name: /sop-write
commands.summary: Draft the SOP in the house shape, every step an instruction to act.

commands.name: /sop-test
commands.summary: Run the novice test and record every stall, question and guess.

commands.name: /sop-fix
commands.summary: Repair the SOP at the cause of each recorded stall.

commands.name: /sop-release
commands.summary: Version it, confirm the owner accepts, set the review date, publish it.

commands.name: /sop-review
commands.summary: Confirm or amend the SOP against the work as it is done now.

commands.name: /sop-retire
commands.summary: Archive a procedure whose work is gone or has been automated.

requires_human_approval_for: publishing a procedure other people will be measured against
changing a step that touches money, safety, compliance or a client commitment
retiring a procedure that anyone still runs
recording an individual's performance in a novice test record
